geopolitical_disruption.description: Index of geopolitical/tariff-regime disruption severity affecting the supplier base.

supplier_financial_health.description: Composite financial-health score of the supplier (higher = healthier).

supplier_distance.description: Geographic distance (km) from supplier to buyer facility.

po_cycle_time.description: Purchase order cycle time in days, from issue to supplier acknowledgment.

lead_time_variability.description: Variability (std-dev-like measure, days) in observed delivery lead times.
lead_time_variability.distribution: SCM: f(geopolitical_disruption, supplier_distance, supplier_risk_score, po_cycle_time) + noise

safety_stock_held.description: Units of safety stock held as a buffer against lead-time variability.

raw_material_delay.description: Observed delay (days) in raw material delivery.
